requirements.statement: Bind IAM policy findings to the exact current AWS documentation snapshot and declared policy scope.
requirements.evidence: Policy, provider scope, and source-lock receipt.

requirements.statement: Do not transfer AWS IAM semantics to another provider or grant account mutation authority.

applicability_rule: Applicability is evaluated from external jurisdiction/entity/activity/data/version/effective-date evidence; this file never stores project facts.
exception_rule: Exceptions require an external primary-source or authority-corpus reference and remain requirement-level mappings.
